description: This file contains automated end-to-end tests for the 'Out of Office' feature in a web application, using Playwright. It tests creating, editing, deleting, and configuring out-of-office entries, including user and team scenarios, date range filters, and redirect configurations.

methods.name: saveAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Submits the form to create or update an out-of-office entry and waits for the server response, verifying the expected status code.

methods.name: selectToAndFromDates
methods.description: Selects a date range in the date picker component for creating or editing an out-of-office entry.

methods.name: selectDateAndCreateOOO
methods.description: Automates the process of selecting date ranges and creating an out-of-office entry, optionally for a team member or in edit mode.

methods.name: goToOOOPage
methods.description: Navigates to the out-of-office page, optionally for team view, and waits for the page to load.

methods.name: openOOODialog
methods.description: Opens the dialog/modal to create a new out-of-office entry.
